piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil W 15W-50
piston-engine-oil.description: Engineered for all-season performance and advanced engine protection, AeroShell Oil W 15W-50 is a premium semi-synthetic multigrade oil formulated by blending high-quality mineral base stocks with over 50% synthetic hydrocarbon fluids. Eliminates seasonal oil changes while delivering rapid cold-weather startup flow and high-temperature film strength. Features ashless dispersant technology, non-metallic anti-rust additives, and the Lycoming LW 16702 anti-wear additive to protect critical camshafts and lifters.
piston-engine-oil.applications: All-season use in aviation piston engines requiring anti-wear, anti-rust, and sludge prevention.

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil Sport Plus 4
piston-engine-oil.description: Engineered in direct partnership with ROTAX, AeroShell Oil Sport Plus 4 is the first dedicated aviation engine oil specially developed for four-stroke light sport piston engines. Utilizing high-quality hydrocarbon base stocks enriched with synthetic technology, it accommodates lower cylinder head temperatures and low oil consumption while maintaining exceptional stability across all operating climates and fuel types.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Four-stroke light sport piston engines (including ROTAX 912 and 914 series), automotive-derived engines (carbureted, fuel-injected, turbocharged) that cannot run on traditional ashless dispersant oils.

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil 100
piston-engine-oil.description: Blended from high viscosity index mineral base stocks, AeroShell Oil 100 is an ashless straight mineral oil designed for certified four-stroke aircraft reciprocating piston engines and radial engines calling for non-dispersant lubricants. Contains minimal additives beyond antioxidants and targeted pour-point depressants for low-temperature fluidity.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Break-in period of new or recently overhauled aviation piston engines to allow proper ring seating (excluding Porsche).

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil W100 Plus
piston-engine-oil.description: Combining premium single-grade ashless dispersant performance with advanced protection, AeroShell Oil W100 Plus is an SAE Grade 50 piston engine oil designed for single-grade reliability with elite anti-wear and anti-corrosion defense. Incorporates the proven AeroShell W additive package, additional anti-corrosion chemistry, and the Lycoming LW 16702 anti-wear additive to protect camshafts and lifters during idle periods and reach TBO. Fully compatible with other approved aviation piston engine oils.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Certified aviation piston engines requiring SAE Grade 50 protection.

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil W120
piston-engine-oil.description: Delivering high-viscosity non-ash dispersant performance, AeroShell Oil W120 combines select high viscosity index mineral base stocks with non-metallic additives to ensure superior stability, dispersancy, and anti-foaming protection with zero metallic ash residues. Maintains engine cleanliness, keeps internal components sludge-free, reduces oil consumption, and protects critical parts against scuffing to help reach TBO.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Heavy-duty, four-stroke certified reciprocating aircraft engines operating under hot conditions or high stress.

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil W100
piston-engine-oil.description: Pioneering non-ash dispersant technology for aviation piston engines, AeroShell Oil W100 combines high viscosity index base stocks with non-metallic additives to ensure exceptional stability, dispersancy, and anti-foaming protection. Eliminates metallic ash residues to prevent combustion chamber deposits and spark plug fouling, keeping engines sludge-free, reducing oil consumption, and protecting against scuffing to reach TBO.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Certified four-stroke reciprocating piston engines (including fuel-injected and turbocharged models).

turbine-engine-oil.name: Eastman Turbo Oil 2380
turbine-engine-oil.summary: High thermal stability for modern turbine engines.
turbine-engine-oil.description: Eastman Turbo Oil 2380 is a 5 cSt synthetic turbine oil used where high thermal stability and reliable oil consumption are required.
turbine-engine-oil.applications: Commercial and military turbine engines approved for this grade.

aviation-greases.name: AeroShell Grease 6
aviation-greases.description: Formulated for reliable, general-purpose airframe maintenance, AeroShell Grease 6 features high-quality mineral oil thickened with Microgel® to deliver outstanding protection across an operating temperature range of -40°C to +121°C. Oxidation- and corrosion-inhibited with superior water resistance and low-noise characteristics.
aviation-greases.applications: Anti-friction bearings, gearboxes, and plain bearings.

aviation-greases.name: AeroShell Grease 7
aviation-greases.description: An advanced, multi-purpose airframe lubricant combining a synthetic ester base oil with Microgel® thickener to deliver exceptional load-carrying capacity and high water resistance. Operating across an ultra-wide temperature range of -73°C to +149°C, this corrosion-inhibited clay-based grease ensures maximum mechanical reliability when paired with compatible seal materials.
aviation-greases.applications: Airframes, highly loaded gears, instruments, and actuator screw mechanisms for both turbine and piston-engine aircraft.

aviation-greases.name: AeroShell Grease 22
aviation-greases.description: AeroShell Grease 22 combines synthetic hydrocarbon oil with Microgel® thickener to deliver exceptional anti-wear, oxidation, and corrosion resistance. Built for high bearing loads, high speeds, and maximum water washout resistance across an extensive temperature range of -65°C to +204°C.
aviation-greases.applications: Aircraft wheel bearings, engine accessories, control systems, actuators, landing gear, and helicopter rotor bearings.

aviation-greases.name: AeroShell Grease 14
aviation-greases.description: Engineered specifically for demanding rotary-wing applications, AeroShell Grease 14 is the industry-leading helicopter multi-purpose grease, blending a calcium soap-thickened mineral oil base with advanced oxidation and corrosion inhibitors. Operating reliably from -54°C to +93°C, its superior anti-fret and anti-moisture properties extend component lifespans in tough operating conditions subjected to heavy vibration.
aviation-greases.applications: Main and tail rotor bearings, splines, and critical airframe components.

aviation-greases.name: Mobil Grease 28
aviation-greases.description: A wide-temperature synthetic grease combining a polyalphaolefin (PAO) base fluid with a non-soap organo-clay thickener (NLGI No. 1 to No. 2 consistency). Features low low-temperature torque, an exceptionally high dropping point (~260°C to 300°C), high water wash-out resistance, and robust protection against friction and fretting.
aviation-greases.applications: Heavy-load aircraft wheel bearings, control surface actuators, landing gear components, and demanding shipboard auxiliary or industrial machinery.
specifications: NATO G-395 (Supersedes MIL-G-81322, MIL-G-7711A, MIL-G-3545B, MIL-G-25760A)

aviation-greases.name: Mobil Grease SHC 100
aviation-greases.description: A synthetic grease combining a wax-free polyalphaolefin (PAO) base fluid with a high-quality lithium complex soap thickener. Formulated to ISO VG 100 viscosity and NLGI Grade 2 consistency, it provides low starting/running torque with cold-temperature pumping resistance typical of mineral-oil Grade 0 lubricants. Operates reliably across -54°C to 177°C (-65°F to 350°F) while delivering a high dropping point, water wash-out resistance, and protection against heavy wear, rust, and corrosion.
aviation-greases.applications: High-speed, heavy-load aircraft wheel bearings, landing gear assemblies, slides, joints, and aerospace chassis applications. Holds approvals from Meggitt, Goodrich, Honeywell, Messier-Bugatti, and Parker-Cleveland.

aviation-greases.name: AeroShell Grease 33
aviation-greases.description: Designed to streamline fleet maintenance and prevent product mis-application, AeroShell Grease 33 is a synthetic universal airframe grease formulated with a lithium complex thickener, oxidation and corrosion inhibitors, and high load-carrying additives across an operating temperature range of -73°C to +121°C. Consolidates inventories by replacing multiple specialized greases, significantly lowering maintenance labor costs.
aviation-greases.applications: Multi-purpose use across major airframe applications.

aviation-greases.name: Nycogrease GN 22
aviation-greases.description: An NLGI 2 synthetic aircraft grease formulated with synthetic hydrocarbon base oil (7 cSt at 100°C) and an inorganic clay thickener. Fortified with anti-wear, extreme pressure, and anti-corrosion inhibitors, it operates reliably across -65°C to +177°C.
aviation-greases.applications: General airframe mechanisms (doors, flaps, slats) as well as heavy-load landing gear components and wheel bearings for civil and military aircraft.

aviation-greases.name: Nycogrease GN 69
aviation-greases.description: A heat-stable silicone electrical insulating grease formulated from silicone oil thickened with a non-melting gelling agent. Operates across a temperature range of -54°C to +204°C to provide dielectric protection and seal out moisture.
aviation-greases.applications: Filling compound in high-tension electrical equipment and ignition systems; protective coating on electrical contacts and electronic circuits.

aviation-greases.name: Nycogrease GN 148
aviation-greases.description: A multipurpose NLGI 2 synthetic aircraft grease formulated from diester and synthetic hydrocarbon base oils thickened with a lithium complex soap. Appearing as a blue-to-green paste, it operates across -73°C to +135°C, providing high resistance to saltwater washout, strong load-carrying capacity, low starting torque, and vibration protection.
aviation-greases.applications: Critical airframe components, doors, slats, flaps, horizontal stabilizers (THS), landing gear assemblies, and high-speed bearings for civil/military aircraft and helicopters.
specifications: NATO G-354 (Replaces MIL-PRF-23827 Types I/II, MIL-G-25537, DEF STAN 91-53, DEF STAN 91-12)

aviation-greases.name: Nycogrease GN 3058
aviation-greases.description: A high-performance white synthetic grease thickened with a lithium complex soap, operating across -54°C to +175°C (-65°F to +347°F). Offers high load-carrying capacity, anti-wear protection, and strong resistance to water washout, salt water, and corrosive de-icing fluids.
aviation-greases.applications: Landing gear, wheel bearings, heavily loaded airframe systems, and aircraft propellers (including Hartzell requirements).

aviation-greases.name: AeroShell Grease 58
aviation-greases.description: Engineered for extreme operating conditions and high-load environments, AeroShell Grease 58 is an advanced synthetic wheel bearing and general-purpose airframe lubricant formulated with a lithium complex soap thickener. Delivering exceptional mechanical stability, oxidation resistance, and wear protection, it operates reliably across a wide temperature range of -54°C to +175°C while offering high resistance to water washout and corrosive fluids.
aviation-greases.applications: Aircraft wheel bearings, actuators, landing gear, and control systems.

speciality-fluids.name: AeroShell Fluid 3
speciality-fluids.summary: Balanced thermal stability for reliable turbine performance.
speciality-fluids.description: AeroShell Fluid 3 is a general-purpose mineral lubricating oil for aircraft instruments and general airframe use.
speciality-fluids.applications: Instruments, general airframe lubrication, and other approved light-duty uses.
